method: scripts/repeatability.py: same photo, same process x3 and two fresh processes; exact comparison of status, flags, every wire's class/status/chord/sag/ratio/resolution/endpoints, and the wire-mask hash; tolerances 1e-6 ratio, 1e-3 px (not needed: all exact)
device: Apple M1 8 GB, MPS, torch 2.15.0, flip TTA

stored_duplicates.note: byte-identical photos uploaded repeatedly (var/uploads SHA-1): results identical within every config fingerprint, different only between fingerprints

conclusion: Inference is deterministic for one code version, configuration and checkpoint set. Observed fluctuation is version drift (configuration and code changed across sessions S4-S12; three servers ran three branches at once).
